title: Feature Comparison
content: Create feature comparison table. Structure: features as rows, plans/products as columns. Header: plan names with highlight on recommended. Cell values: checkmarks, x marks, text values, or partial indicators. Feature groups: section headers grouping related features. Sticky: sticky header for scrolling. Highlight column: emphasized styling on featured plan. Tooltips: extra info on features. Mobile: horizontal scroll or accordion layout. Pricing: row for price with per-month/year. CTA: action buttons per column (Sign up, Contact sales).

variants.simple: Build comparison table for features or pricing plans.
variants.detailed: Create feature comparison table. Structure: features as rows, plans/products as columns. Header: plan names with highlight on recommended. Cell values: checkmarks, x marks, text values, or partial indicators. Feature groups: section headers grouping related features. Sticky: sticky header for scrolling. Highlight column: emphasized styling on featured plan. Tooltips: extra info on features. Mobile: horizontal scroll or accordion layout. Pricing: row for price with per-month/year. CTA: action buttons per column (Sign up, Contact sales).
variants.advanced: Create comprehensive feature comparison table for pricing or product comparison. Structure: matrix with products/plans as columns, features as rows. Header row: plan names, pricing, recommended badge, CTA buttons. Feature cells: check icon (included), x icon (not included), text/number (limits like "5 users"), partial (limited with tooltip). Feature groupings: section headers spanning full width ("Core Features", "Advanced Features", "Support"), collapsible groups for long lists. Sticky header: position: sticky top-0 for scroll, with shadow when scrolled. Column highlighting: recommended/popular plan with distinct background, border, or "Most Popular" badge. Tooltips: info icon on features with hover tooltip explaining feature, or on cells explaining limitations. Pricing row: monthly/annual pricing with toggle, show savings for annual, crossed out higher price. Mobile handling: horizontal scroll with sticky first column (feature names), or switch to card layout per plan, or accordion comparing each feature across plans. Responsive columns: hide less important columns on mobile, show expand to see all. CTA row: action buttons per plan (Get Started, Contact Sales), style primary on recommended. Schema markup: Product structured data for SEO. Sticky column: optionally sticky feature name column for wide tables. Empty/null handling: dash for not applicable features. Annual savings: calculate and show "Save 20%" badge on annual pricing.
